description: Curate diverse/difficult reasoning SFT examples by scoring only the first ~100 reasoning tokens at perturbed checkpoints; improves token efficiency during data selection.
training_prompt: Given a batch of candidate reasoning traces (problem + chain-of-thought + answer), propose an inexpensive heuristic to rank examples by difficulty/diversity using only the first 100 reasoning tokens; output a ranked list and rationale.
expected_improvement: sample_efficiency_trend and transfer_learning_rate by improving the quality/coverage of reasoning fine-tuning data with lower curation cost.

technique: Evolutionary Ensemble of Agents (EvE) with Elo-based credit assignment
description: Maintain co-evolving populations of code solvers and guidance states; evaluate via synchronous races and update Elo ratings from marginal contribution, enabling stage-adaptive agent behavior.
training_prompt: Design an agentic loop that runs N coding agents in parallel, scores each by marginal contribution to a shared solution, and evolves their guidance prompts; specify evaluation, selection, mutation, and stopping criteria.
expected_improvement: recursive_self_improvement_rate and agentic_capability_score by enabling a structured self-revision loop with measurable contribution signals.

description: Tree-structured hypothesis management with systematic backtracking; reflections act as verbal gradients/momentum and memory compression as semantic weight decay for research dynamics.
training_prompt: Given an open-ended optimization task, produce a branching research tree (hypotheses, experiments, backtracks). After each step, write short-term and long-term reflections and compress them into persistent memory entries.
expected_improvement: agentic_capability_score and metacognition_accuracy by improving structured planning/backtracking and reflective memory management.

technique: Advantage re-weighting to prevent entropy collapse in RLVR reasoning
description: Re-weights advantages using prompt perplexity and answer confidence to redistribute probability mass toward under-explored correct reasoning chains, improving Pass@k and diversity.
training_prompt: Propose a reward-shaping/advantage re-weighting method for an RLVR reasoning agent that avoids mode collapse; include which signals (perplexity, confidence) you would log and how you would update weights.
expected_improvement: zero_shot_success_count and transfer_learning_rate by preserving diverse correct solution paths under RL fine-tuning.

technique: Persistent agent memory with combined graph + vector retrieval
description: An open-source memory layer for agents offering remember/recall/forget/improve operations with graph + vector + session memory backends.
training_prompt: Implement (or simulate) a four-function memory API (remember/recall/forget/improve) and demonstrate how an agent uses it to maintain long-term user preferences across sessions with retrieval + summarization.
expected_improvement: metacognition_accuracy and multi_modal_integration_score via better long-term memory and structured retrieval.

technique: Declarative LM programs with prompt/weight optimization loops
description: Framework for programming LMs as modular pipelines that can be optimized (prompts/weights) for tasks including retrieval, multi-stage programs, and agent loops.
training_prompt: Convert a brittle prompt-only workflow into a modular program with explicit signatures and an optimization loop; define evaluation metrics and show how the optimizer updates instructions/demos.
expected_improvement: skill_acquisition_rate and transfer_learning_rate by turning prompts into optimizable programs with measurable feedback.
